name: Perfectly Balanced Gauntlets
body:
Price 7,500 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

These gauntlets are slight and their surface seems to shimmer like liquid glass. While worn the gauntlets grant you the use of Two-Weapon Fighting feat even if you do not meet the prerequisites. If you possess the Two-Weapon Fighting feat already the gauntlets instead grant the use of Improved Two-Weapon Fighting. You are not considered to possess either feat for the purpose of meeting other prerequisites.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,750 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, haste
